decisions.notes: The assigned decorated welcome room, exact greeting, sixty-second personal countdown, early pad and same-place outdoor entry are implemented; each acceptance item is mapped here. Outstanding rehearsals remain explicit.

One shared world and per-player server-owned entry preserve the intended scope. No invented note, economy or forced outdoor camera loop. Actual touch controls and two-client manual camera independence remain pending.
Actual Play view clearly shows the exact greeting, countdown, birthday decorations and favorite-things displays. Indoor lighting is coherent, and no personal birthday note has been generated.

Actual installed lobby sources were parsed and compared; independent final Edit capture has 597 exact-color parts. Real multiplayer timer/state tests and separate early-E Play check ran in this place. Saved checkpoint matches final live revision provenance.
Desktop early E, visible HUD, automatic expiry, physical routes and seat exit pass. The full flow on touch controls remains untested; do not generalize desktop evidence to all target controls.

Actual pre-entry reset, three world resets, late join and disconnected-slot replacement pass. Replacement by a fresh guest is not an observed same-user reconnect; a same-user reconnect demonstration remains pending.
No named phone/tablet device or touch emulation completion evidence exists. Desktop HUD and E input were observed.

Three concurrent actual clients demonstrate independent automatic deadlines, late join, distinct slots, disconnect release and fresh replacement. Manual early entry while another client waits, independent orbit and same-user reconnect are not all demonstrated.
Fresh actual players are placed safely in Lobby before the deadline begins. Actual Play image shows the full readable Happy 24th Birthday, Phuong greeting.

Decorations/displays and eight native seats exist with a clear central route; a real player sat in one lobby seat and detached at expiry. All eight occupied seats/central circulation have not been rehearsed.

Server deadline event is 60 seconds after start; actual initial remaining time is within 55–60. Play HUD shows 40s and source recomputes ceil(deadline-server time). Full measured deadline-event-to-entry duration 60.064 seconds.

Actual timer expiry places only the expired player at outdoor arrival with no countdown state. Separate manual entry hides HUD and leaves movable Custom-camera character; normal-speed destination walking passes.

Actual E at the pad enters early and hides HUD. Independent source review confirms server-side alive-character, lobby-region and prompt-distance checks before transition, with no client-supplied destination. Negative spoof/distance inputs were reviewed statically rather than exercised in this engine run.

Per-player server state and independent automatic expiry are proven; reset/late join leave the waiting deadline unchanged. Early pad was exercised separately on one client, so simultaneous early-entry effect on another actual camera/deadline remains unobserved.

Corrected per-character readiness starts a new deadline only for the reset lobby player. Actual reset-before-entry scenario and full replacement countdown pass; generation/source guards discard stale character work and the client reuses one named HUD.

Three actual world resets stay physically near outdoor arrival without a new lobby deadline. Late guest has a separate countdown, disconnected slot is released and a fresh guest reuses it without moving existing world players.

Actual seated expiry detaches the character and leaves furniture. Idempotent transition guards were reviewed in source, but a simultaneous prompt/expiry race was not deliberately exercised in this engine run.

Three actual clients plus replacement guest demonstrate presence, late join and distinct slots; allocator handles up to eight available slots by source review. Separate manual cameras, concurrent early entry, same-user reconnect and eight-person placement rehearsal remain pending.
Desktop countdown and E prompt are observed. Touch readability/input and manual orbit on both control types have not been demonstrated.

Installed scripts independently parse, match the tested source apart from a trailing insertion CRLF, and keep destination/deadline server-owned. All 15 actual engine scenario checks pass with exact tested file SHA bindings. Single-client changed-flow console query returned no messages; unobserved multiplayer-client logs are not claimed clean.

All 597 lobby native token/color pairs pass with zero color textures. UI palette assignments and actual Play appearance were reviewed. Final saved working file/checkpoint hashes match the reviewed place provenance.

Local room-to-world flow and editable saved place meet implementation scope without publishing or invented content. Complete device/group/race/reconnect rehearsals and genuine human clarity/fun/final acceptance remain pending.
